checks: Native content build projection binds both frozen curves across T1..T5 (0.15/0.175/0.2/0.225/0.25 as exact fractions 3/20, 7/40, 1/5, 9/40, 1/4) against the frozen DataList order (buff_PoliceRat_AtkUp order 1, buff_PoliceRat_Up order 2, both bIsPercent=True), pins all four unit hints (AtkUp/Up/SkillDamage percent, Rat_CD seconds), enforces ApplyGroupType ONE against the wearer group, rejects a flipped bIsPercent unit hint and cross-group wearers (character:1019, group TWO), and asserts the native description text and key buff_fork_PoliceRat_effect.
Config validation: a proc on weapon:fork_PaperPlane is rejected ('requires equipped'), duplicate police-rat procs are rejected ('duplicates'), and a legal config validates.
Untagged real scenario run (T5): 1000 static ATK + 1000 base ATK * 1/4 = 1250 non-crit at 0 DEF/0 RES vs 1000 without the proc (ratio 5/4); M_bonus stays 1 on a non-Boss target.
T1 frozen-end anchor in a real scenario run: 1000 static ATK + 1000 base ATK * 3/20 = 1150 non-crit on an untagged target.

Tagged-arm zone math (real executed adapter + core exact zones): a Boss-tagged target yields atk_percent 1/4 and damage_bonus 1/4 from the real crate::gear::damage_bonus on a tagged GameSimulatorState; settling 1250 * (1 + 1/4) through the core exact evaluator gives 3125/2 (a real hit receipt would quantize to 1563 per COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 6). Untagged yields zero damage bonus.

Additive-placement falsifier: the same 1/4 as a static actor bonus plus the 1/4 Boss bonus settles to 1250 * 3/2 = 1875, while final-zone placement of the Boss ratio would give 1250 * 5/4 * 5/4 = 15625/8 (1953.125), which is rejected.

Active-tag gating: a tag expired before the hit (1 us duration, queried at 10 us) grants zero damage bonus while the ATK percentage stays unconditional; two active tagged stacks still grant exactly 1/4 (the adapter gates on boss > 0 and adds the ratio once).
The two summon-arc DataList entries (buff_PoliceRat_SkillDamage, buff_Rat_CD) are unit-pinned but never projected: compiled_proc carries only atk_bonus and boss_damage_bonus.

independent_oracles: T5 ATK part: 1000 static ATK + 1000 base ATK * 1/4 = 1250 non-crit damage at 0 DEF/0 RES in a real scenario run; 1000 without the proc (ratio 5/4); M_bonus stays 1 on a non-Boss target. (police_rat_atk_bonus_joins_base_scaled_atk_sum_unconditionally)
T1 frozen end: 1000 + 1000 * 3/20 = 1150 non-crit in a real scenario run; tagged zone modifiers carry atk_percent 3/20 and damage_bonus 3/20. (police_rat_t1_frozen_curve_end_anchored_in_real_run)

Boss-gated zone: the real executed adapter yields damage_bonus 1/4 on a Boss-tagged target and 0 on an untagged target, with atk_percent 1/4 in both arms. (police_rat_boss_tagged_end_to_end_zone_math)
Tagged hit settles through the core exact zones to 1250 * 5/4 = 3125/2; the untagged arm settles to 1250/1 and agrees with the real scenario run. (police_rat_boss_tagged_end_to_end_zone_math)

known_gaps: Global release availability is unverified in the frozen catalog.

Boss detection uses the content-owned ntesim.status.boss target status tag; the engine carries no Boss flag on targets and the frozen tables expose no boss binding. Boss identity via target metadata is an open Q1-V1 follow-up, deliberately not fixed here: Boss-tagged defeats only occur when a scenario declares the tag.

The Arc: Officer Whisker summon (buff_PoliceRat_SkillDamage, buff_Rat_CD) is explicitly out of scope (Q1-V4 gap): summons have no engine representation, so those curves are observed for unit-hint pinning but never projected or consumed.

The tagged-arm zone math drives the real executed adapter (crate::gear::damage_bonus on a tagged GameSimulatorState) plus the core exact damage zones; no production path injects the tag into a full scenario run, so the tagged hit is not a whole-scenario execution. The untagged arm is anchored against a real scenario run.
Web tests were authored but not executed here: no WASM build exists in this Linux environment; they are written for CI.

tested_hypotheses: The {0} ATK percentage is unconditional and joins the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum (base_atk * p added to ATK), never multiplying compiled static ATK.

The {1} Boss damage ratio joins the single additive damage-bonus zone (M_bonus) only while the target carries an active Boss tag; it is not a final, special, or multiplicative factor, and multiple active tags do not multiply it.

Boss state is detected through the content-owned ntesim.status.boss target status tag; the tag name is not asserted to be the native GameplayTag because the frozen tables expose no boss binding and the engine carries no Boss flag on targets.
The Arc: Officer Whisker summon curves are observed for unit-hint pinning but never projected or consumed; summons are not modeled by the engine.
Frozen package evidence does not establish Global release availability.
